checks.name: evaluator_cli_help
checks.stdout:
usage: freerun.py [-h] {bind,prepare,inspect,run} ...

Plan-first replay-BC free-running evaluation, task-local to slot 81. prepare
reads metadata only; run is an explicit maintainer native-game operation. The
injectable Python backend is for reduced software fixtures, never strength.

positional arguments:
  {bind,prepare,inspect,run}
    bind                read-only exact full-economic checkpoint binding;
                        pinned runtime required
    prepare             freeze worlds/streams/opponents/settings without
                        opening weights
    inspect             validate a plan without checkpoint or native-game
                        execution
    run                 MAINTAINER ONLY: execute the complete prospectively
                        fixed comparison

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

checks.name: required_training_cli_help
checks.stdout:
usage: moe_lab.py [-h]
                  {teacher,teacher-witness,public-replay,public-check,bc,bc-current,selfplay} ...

Bounded full-economics MoE/teacher lab using the existing exact engine.
Teacher imitation is PARTIAL ACTION BC, never fabricated latent plan labels or
terminal RL admission. Production PPO continuation is a separate next step.
All outputs are new, source-bound work/runs children; no frozen actor is
edited. Public replay imports instead use the declared separate corpus mount.
They reuse observed-prefix BC, not fabricated full-plan targets or old BC
resume identities.

positional arguments:
  {teacher,teacher-witness,public-replay,public-check,bc,bc-current,selfplay}
    public-replay       winner SFT prefixes from the declared external replay
                        corpus
    public-check        fresh raw reconstruction and tensor re-extraction, no
                        fit
    bc-current          supervised stage preserving current fast-model
                        Adam/RNG/age, then resume RL

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
